build_MeanField_model: build a MeanField CRF model with spatial and chromatic sigma for bilateral or trilateral meanfield inference
create_BilateralCRF_wrapper: create a BilateralCRF wrapper that initializes a MeanField filter with non-temporal spatial and chromatic sigma
create_TrilateralCRF_wrapper: create a TrilateralCRF wrapper that initializes a MeanField filter with temporal spatial and chromatic sigma
review_MeanField_initialize_coords: review the MeanField initialize_coords method that builds trilateral grid coordinates and sparse matrix mappings
